Subject: Post-demo: Healthlytics security intake + pen test & vuln process

Tom — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so your security and procurement teams have what they need to evaluate Redwood for the Healthlytics pilot.

Key security items we discussed:
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) — I can share the summary and scope.
- Data residency & GDPR/HIPAA: Hosted option supports US regions and we offer a Private VPC package for HIPAA-regulated workflows.
- Pen test: we run annual third-party pen tests and rolling internal vuln scans; customers often ask for a redacted pen test report and a description of our vuln remediation SLA.

Immediate asks / asks for you to confirm:
1) Please share the preferred intake contact for your security team (email + best time to sync).
2) Can you confirm if Healthlytics requires a full pen-test report or a redacted/exec summary? (Some customers require signed NDA before full report delivery.)
3) Any specific compliance docs you need right away (e.g., Data Processing Addendum, BAAs for HIPAA)?

What we'll attach in a follow-up: SOC 2 summary, our vulnerability process with SLA (critical/high/medium definitions and remediation targets), and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) with timelines.

Next step proposal: 30-minute intake call with your security + procurement next week (I can coordinate).

Thanks — Marissa

--

Tom / Healthlytics team — hi, Aditya on the security/ops side at Redwood. Thanks for the quick reply and the VSQ. A few concrete items from Redwood to address your asks: 

SOC 2: attached is a one-page SOC 2 summary (Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf). We can share the full SOC 2 Type II report under an MSA/NDA request process; let us know if Legal prefers an exec summary first.

Pen test & reporting cadence:
- Third-party pen test: annual, last completed March 2025 (third-party vendor). We can provide a redacted executive report containing findings, risk ratings, and mitigation status.
- Authenticated scanning: weekly authenticated scans for web-facing components; daily unauthenticated CI/CD scans for container images and IaC templates.
- Remediation SLA (typical customer baseline):
  - Critical (active exploit / data exposure): 72 hours to mitigation plan + continuous remediation until closed.
  - High (serious vuln, no known exploit): 7 business days to remediation plan; 14 calendar days target to close where feasible.
  - Medium: 30 calendar days.
  - Low: tracked in backlog, quarterly remediation windows.

Vuln disclosure & customer communication: we provide customers with an incident summary and remediation timeline for any findings that affect them; we coordinate with customers on timing for disclosures if there is risk of customer-impacting exposure.

On the VSQ: we can complete your form directly. If you prefer upload to a vendor portal we can do that as well — share credentials or an upload link.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf, RDW-Vuln-Process-SLA-2025.docx (detailed process & SLA examples), HTX-MAP-20250514.xlsx (draft mutual action plan with proposed owners/timeline).

We are happy to accept an NDA to provide the full pen test report. For the MAP, suggested owners: Marissa (commercial), Aditya (security ops), Healthlytics InfoSec (Tom).

I'll attend the intake call on 20 May at 2pm ET if that works.

Thanks — Aditya
